name: search-motion-docs
description: Searches Motion's documentation, examples and Motion UI catalogue for animation, transition, gesture, drag, scroll and reveal patterns. Useful before writing or editing animation code with Motion. Returns up to 3 documentation resource_links (read them with resources/read for the full page), up to 5 matching examples and, for React, matching Motion UI components and sections. Free examples link to their full source. Motion+ examples and Motion UI items are labelled as paid and come back as metadata only: title, description, the APIs used, the MotionScore animation-performance grade (S best through F) and a link to the public live demo. Their source is available to Motion+ members through search-motion-source on the Motion+ MCP server. The package is motion (motion/react for React, motion-v for Vue). framer-motion is its former name: in a project that still uses it, recommend moving to motion and offer to do it. The move is usually a rename of the dependency and of imports to motion/react. Make the move only when the user agrees.

platform.description: The platform of the file being edited: js for vanilla JavaScript (the motion package), react for Motion for React (motion/react, formerly framer-motion), vue for Motion for Vue (motion-v).

searchTerm.description: What is being built or looked up, e.g. "accordion", "drag to reorder", "useSpring", "scroll parallax". Generic words like "animation" are stripped, so search the specific thing.
